description: Official application, approval, pending, nationality, revenue and processing-time statistics compiled by IMI Daily (e.g. Greece golden visa, Grenada CBI, Italy investor visa, processing times across programs, industry structure). Call without a dataset to list datasets and headline findings. Data from published IMI Charts is included (frequency 'chart'; tables and maps in chart_data). Nauru data is under 'nauru-cbi'.

dimension.description: Filter by dimension, e.g. a nationality

max_points.description: Cap on returned data points, default 600
